profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Northwestern grad starting out in the Pacific Northwest

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Software Engineer for the Bing Ads Campaign Platform Team

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Served as a TA in Northwestern's Electrical Engineering and Computer Science Department (EECS) for the Fundamental Computer Programming (EECS 111) and Introduction to Artificial Intelligence (EECS 348) courses under Professors Sara Sood and Ian Horswill 
• Responsibilities included leading discussion sections, holding office hours for students, and grading exams

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Interned as a Software Engineer for the Bing Ads Campaign Platform Team
• Worked on various projects to improve and expand the functionality, maintainability, and scalability of the Bing Ads middle tier and backend components using C#, .Net, and SQL

positions.title: Mobile Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Interned as a mobile developer at Solstice Mobile in Chicago, building a native iOS and Android healthcare app for a local hospital and a mobile web-based app for distributing apps internally and to clients of the company
• Responsibilities included building mobile web, iPhone (Objective-C), Android (Java), Enterprise Java, and .NET applications; assisting the IT department with projects such as website development/improvements; gaining technical knowledge of software, hardware and open source technologies; working with social media and assisting with marketing department projects; and learning about proper code documentation

positions.title: Computer Consultant
positions.description:
• Worked in computer consulting/information technology for the Engineering and Science Computing department during summer and winter breaks
• Responsibilities included configuring computers, printers, and other machines; installing and upgraded software and hardware; and providing other technical support and consulting to faculty, staff, and students in the Colleges of Engineering and Science

honors.title: National Merit Scholar
honors.issuer: Issued by National Merit Scholarship Corporation · Mar 2012

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Aug 2011

volunteerExperiences.description: IRS-certified volunteer tax preparer for United Way of King County's Free Tax Preparation Campaign, a program that helps low-income people prepare and file their taxes for free and ensure they get all the refunds and credits that they’re eligible for.

projects.title: CamRub App
projects.description:
• Created, designed, and developed an iOS app (AppStore.com/CamRub) which fuses photography and drawing, allowing users to capture select portions of an image by "rubbing," or drawing on a camera view
• Designed a responsive website (NDHApps.com) and coordinated other marketing efforts to promote the app

projects.title: CoffeeChat
projects.description:
• Worked with a team to create, design, and develop a web platform for connecting employees or community members in companies and organizations that are looking to start a mentorship program, build community, and/or retain employees
• Built a working web app using SQL and Node.js that features profile pages, admin tools and metrics, and automated algorithmic matching, and helped pilot the product with various companies and organization through Northwestern University's NUvention: Web + Media course

organizations.name: Sigma Nu Fraternity, Gamma Beta Chapter
organizations.position: Brother, Public Relations Committee Chairman, Candidate Education Committee member, Website Committee member · Apr 2013 - Present
organizations.description:
• Brother and re-founding father of Northwestern’s Sigma Nu Gamma Beta chapter
• Public Relations Chairman, and member of the Candidate Education and Website Committees

organizations.name: Engineers for a Sustainable World, Clean Energy Project
organizations.description:
• Worked with a team to develop the ReNU Shower Monitor, an electronic device that indicates water usage and gives cues to encourage the conservation of water in Northwestern University residence halls
• Serving as project manager for the 2014-2015 schoolyear
